title.narrative: 10 Years of UNGPs: Quo Vadis Academia?

description.narrative: This project will develop further the capacity of academia through a national academic conference on Business and Human Rights (BHR) that would be preceded by a workshop. Outputs: 1) Workshop, will be conducted online for 1.5 (one and a half) days to cover basic material on BHR basic concepts and specific issues pertaining to BHR, for instance corporate liability, human rights and natural resources exploitation, BHR and vulnerable groups, BHR and climate change, modern slavery, BHR and SDGs. 2) National Academic Conference on BHR. The conference aims to address the issues and approaches of BHR in the areas of (a) BHR learning and teaching, (b) regulatory frameworks, (c) global instruments, (d) access remedy, and (e) vulnerable groups. Output of this national conference is in the form of publication in national journals
